description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle data source, schema, and repository SQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including the photo BLOB-to-bytea conversion and Managed Identity authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC configuration, BLOB data, and plaintext credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service, and the migration plan specifies Managed Identity authentication.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for PostgreSQL, and point application.properties and application-docker.properties to the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint. Convert Oracle BLOB photo storage to PostgreSQL bytea and adapt Oracle-specific repository SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents. Replace plaintext database credentials with Managed Identity authentication.
